2.5.1. An Advanced Water Purification System to improve recycled water quality using microfiltration followed by reverse osmosis to reduce the level of total dissolved solids.

The Discharger’s planned Advanced Water Purification System would improve recycled water quality by adding additional membrane filtration and reverse osmosis for up to 1.125 MGD of the recycled water flow, with the potential to expand to up to 2.25 MGD.

2.5.2. Upgrades to the biological treatment process to enhance total inorganic nitrogen removal. The project would remove the fixed film reactors from the treatment train and add nitrogen removal and membrane aerated biofilm reactor process units to the existing aeration basins to improve and intensify the treatment process.
